answer.text: The TrailPeak 2-Person Tent had by far the most product fault tickets in NZ-NORTH across March and April 2026, with 91 of the 159 total. Next were Southward Ear Muffs 50 (4), Bushcraft Cooler 62 (3), and Bushcraft Trekking Poles 35 and Kea Gas Heater 92 (2 each).

sql.sql:
select p.product_name as product, count(*) as tickets_opened
from marts.fct_tickets as t
inner join marts.dim_product as p on p.product_key = t.product_key
where t.opened_date between %(start_date)s and %(end_date)s and t.region = any(%(filter_0)s) and t.category = any(%(filter_1)s)
group by 1
order by 2 desc nulls last
limit %(row_limit)s

group by 1
